summary.name: Sista.AI
summary.one_liner: Sista.AI is a set of AI coaching chatbots (life, fitness, career, relationship, language, finance) that you chat with on WhatsApp, Telegram, or ChatGPT.
summary.what_it_does: Sista.AI offers AI coaches with distinct personas for life, fitness, career, relationship, language, and finance topics. The fitness coach, Alex Armstrong, is described as designing personalized workout and nutrition plans and providing injury prevention guidance. Users reach the coaches through WhatsApp, Telegram, ChatGPT, or the web. The page says the coaches remember user context, check in proactively, and support over 50 languages. Conversations are described as unlimited and free, with no signup required.
notable: Six specialized AI coach personas, including Alex Armstrong for fitness and nutrition
Proactive check-ins and memory of user context
caveats: The page describes coaching as a chatbot, not a certified human trainer or medical provider; no credentials are listed
Listing tag says #paid, which conflicts with the page's claim of completely free conversations; pricing details are not confirmed on the page
